verdict.rationale: React's docs mention that on the server React can stream HTML progressively while still fetching data, filling in content before JS loads, which is closely related to progressive hydration and improves time-to-interactive (react-docs-6, react-docs-7). However, the evidence pack never explicitly names selective/progressive hydration APIs (e.g., hydrateRoot, startTransition-based hydration prioritization) or shows hands-on confirmation of the hydration mechanics themselves. missing for 10: explicit mention of hydrateRoot/selective hydration API, independent/hands-on evidence confirming faster interactivity via progressive hydration.
